## Architecture Checklist

- [ ] Feature code imports Basecamp packages instead of directly coupling to external vendors.
- [ ] Web UI code uses `@basecamp/ui` for approved components and Kaizen adapters.
- [ ] Data changes include migration, seed, export, and backup considerations.
- [ ] Offline/mobile sync impact has been considered.
- [ ] Accessibility impact has been considered.
- [ ] Tests or documented manual validation are included.
